blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (всегда + ли) рекомендовано хирургическое вмешательство?
exercises.prompt: Is surgery always recommended?
exercises.why: **Всегда ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (всегда): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Я проверяю, ___ (работать + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) снова языковое распознавание.
exercises.prompt: I'm testing whether the language detection works again.
exercises.why: **работать → работает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Том знал, что его ___ (навряд + ли) изберут.
exercises.prompt: Tom knew that he was unlikely to be elected.
exercises.why: **навряд ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (навряд): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (много + ли) песца в тундре?
exercises.prompt: Are there many arctic foxes in the tundra?
exercises.why: **Много ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (много): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (означать + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) это, что Робу этой ночью улыбнулась удача?
exercises.prompt: Does that mean Rob is getting lucky tonight?
exercises.why: **означать → Означает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (нет + ли) у вас сигаретки?
exercises.prompt: Can you spare a cigarette?
exercises.why: **Нет ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (нет): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (излечимый + ли) анальные трещины?
exercises.prompt: Are anal fissures curable?
exercises.why: **излечимый → Излечимы ли** — short form (plural): -ы. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Извините, ___ (далеко + ли) отсюда до ресторана Синьцяо?
exercises.prompt: Excuse me, is Xinqiao Restaurant far from here?
exercises.why: **далеко ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (далеко): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Если я посею этот камешек, ___ (вырасти + ли, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) гора?
exercises.prompt: If I sow this pebble, will a mountain grow?
exercises.why: **вырасти → вырастет ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Не ___ (быть + ли, impf., fut. 3rd sg.) это несколько противоречиво?
exercises.prompt: Wouldn't that be a bit contradictory?
exercises.why: **быть → будет ли** — future of быть: 3rd person singular. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (действительно + ли) Бог приказывает мусульманам убивать немусульман?
exercises.prompt: Does God really command Muslims to kill non-Muslims?
exercises.why: **Действительно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (действительно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: В моём отце ___ (едва + ли) найдётся артистизм.
exercises.prompt: My father is far from artistic.
exercises.why: **едва ли** — a set phrase: «hardly, unlikely».

exercises.q: Так-так, уходить из-за стола посреди обеда - дурной тон, ___ (знать + ли, impf., pres. 2nd sg.).
exercises.prompt: Oh my, leaving the table in the middle of a meal is bad manners, you know.
exercises.why: **знать → знаешь ли** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (хватать + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) у вас капканов?
exercises.prompt: Do you have enough traps?
exercises.why: **хватать → Хватает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Это ___ (вряд + ли) изменится.
exercises.prompt: This isn't likely to change.
exercises.why: **вряд ли** — a set phrase: «hardly, unlikely».

exercises.q: ___ (расти + ли, impf., pres. 3rd pl.) поэмы на поэтических деревьях?
exercises.prompt: Do poems grow on poet trees?
exercises.why: **расти → Растут ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (являться + ли, impf., pres. 3rd sg.) слово "несамодескриптивное" самодескриптивным?
exercises.prompt: Is "heterological" a homological word?
exercises.why: **являться → Является ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Не ___ (слишком + ли) солёное?
exercises.prompt: Does it have too much salt?
exercises.why: **слишком ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (слишком): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли, impf., pres. 3rd pl.) ники меняться?
exercises.prompt: Can usernames be changed?
exercises.why: **мочь → Могут ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (можно + ли) умереть от синусита?
exercises.prompt: Can you die of sinusitis?
exercises.why: **Можно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (можно): a yes/no question.
